title: Grateful Dead Live at Community Concourse on 1970-01-10
lineage: RX > Technics RS-1506 > Grace Design Lunatec V3 [Pre-Only] > Korg MR-1000 > DSF [1-bit 5.6448 MHz Stereo] > Korg AudioGate > wav [24/96]
source: MR > R1 > RX (purported to be 2nd gen)

ai_review.summary: Fair soundboard capture with garbled early sections but a high‑voltage Jerry on Good Lovin' and a standout Lovelight finale.
ai_review.review: The recording shows its age, sounding a bit garbled at the start, yet it clears up toward the end where Good Lovin' bursts through with fresh energy. Jerry’s guitar on the closing Lovelight is described as high‑voltage and uniquely spirited, while Pigpen’s soulful vocals add to the magical feel of the night.

ai_rating.rationale: One detailed review gives a solid 4‑star rating, praising the performance and standout songs despite noting recording imperfections.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Early parts are garbled and sound dusty; later sections (Good Lovin' and Lovelight) sound clearer and more vibrant.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The show builds toward a rewarding climax, with the band delivering strong energy in the final songs that compensate for earlier weaker moments.

band_member_comments.Jerry: High‑voltage guitar playing, especially on the Lovelight, noted as unique.
band_member_comments.Keys: Pigpen's voice is strong and soulful, adding depth to the performance.
